rows.title: Potential effects of β-hydroxy-β-methylbutyrate and exercise on brain aging and age-related disorders: implications for immunometabolic regulation and muscle-brain-immune crosstalk.
rows.evidence_boundary: Direct CNS evidence is limited; many studies use multicomponent interventions, so HMB-specific effects cannot be isolated.

rows.title: The role of hormonal and nutritional biomarkers in predicting immune checkpoint inhibitor efficacy: current limitations and future prospects.
rows.evidence_boundary: Host-directed biomarker/intervention concepts remain heterogeneous and largely observational or preclinical.

rows.title: Beyond Bone Health: Exploring the "Heart-Brain-Bone" Axis Modulated by Lipid-Soluble Nutrients (Omega-3, Vitamin D3, and Vitamin K2).
rows.evidence_boundary: The proposed axis is conceptual; no adequately powered RCT establishes superiority of the combined omega-3/D3/K2 regimen.

rows.title: Krill Oil in Human Nutrition and Healthy Aging: A Narrative Review of Implications for Intrinsic Capacity and Nutrient Bioavailability.
rows.evidence_boundary: Narrative synthesis and compositional plausibility do not establish broad healthy-aging clinical benefit.

rows.title: Food-Derived Omega-3 Fatty Acids and Cognitive Aging: Integrating Nutritional Neuroscience and Geroscience.
rows.evidence_boundary: Observational signals are more consistent than RCT findings; heterogeneity prevents firm efficacy conclusions.
